Add "name" label to "argocd_cluster_connection_status" metric, in addition to "server"

# Motivation

I have a prometheus rule set to alert me when Argo is unable to connect to a cluster, by monitoring if the metric "argocd_cluster_connection_status" is 0 for one of my connected clusters.
